opening.argument: The evidence shows a recruitment-based earning scheme presented through Forsage registration, not an ordinary wallet tutorial. The description promotes Forsage as an “online earning platform” and says it is “best online earning platform in all world” for earning money at home. The narration directs viewers to copy a referral link, check an upliner, connect a wallet, approve BUSD, and confirm the transaction. The registration screen reinforces that structure by displaying registration availability, wallet connection, Smart Chain, and an Approve BUSD control. References to an inviter, upliner, Forsage programs, and priority-leader language place participation within a referral and team hierarchy, with earning activity tied to recruitment and tiered participation.
